Subject: Aurora Health POC: success criteria, plan, and readout scheduling

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — good to align on goals and constraints. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the POC timeline: 

Recap / proposed scope:
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization at Aurora Health (throughput and quality).
- Primary success criteria (draft): 1) >= 85% QA pass rate on 200 sampled notes (per your review rubric); 2) 95th percentile LLM response latency < 500ms for 512-token prompts; 3) end-to-end cost estimate within target you shared (~$X/token).

Proposed POC plan (high-level):
- Week 1: Data access + baseline export (Aurora delivers sample dataset; Redwood runs baseline model).
- Week 2–3: Integration + config (connectors, tokenization, batching configs).
- Week 4: Evaluation run + readout prep.

Owners (draft):
- Aurora: Priya (product) — dataset & reviewer panel; Sam — exec sponsor
- Redwood: Marissa — program lead; Marcus — SE lead; Neha — customer success (onboarding & ROI measurement)

Attachments: Aurora_POC_Success_Criteria_v1.xlsx (draft) and Aurora_POC_Timeline_and_Roles.pdf.

Questions / asks from you to confirm: 
1) Can you confirm a technical contact who can provision a sample dataset (SFTP or secure Share)?
2) Are the draft success criteria plausible or do we need to adjust thresholds or sample sizes?
3) For the final readout, does the week of June 28 work for an exec-level 30–45 minute slot?

If that week works, we’ll schedule a dry-run with the Aurora review panel on June 26 to walk through results.

Thanks — I’ll update the plan based on your feedback and loop in procurement when we’re closer to the readout.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa / team —

Following Sam’s note, I put together a technical POC playbook (attached) and an implementation checklist. Highlights:

- Baseline run: I can spin up a baseline job using our 13B open model and report accuracy metrics vs. Aurora’s provided ground truth. Need SFTP + sample schema.
- Connectors: Two options — SFTP ingest (fast to stand up) or secure S3 bucket with presigned URLs. Recommend SFTP for the initial run to avoid IAM setup.
- Latency tuning: Configure batching window = 25ms and dynamic KV cache; target 95th < 500ms on g5.12xlarge equivalent.
- Evaluation: We'll produce (a) per-note QA breakdown, (b) aggregate pass rate, (c) latency and cost projection per 1,000 notes.

Action items for us: 
1) Confirm dataset transfer method (ask Aurora).
2) Prep baseline job and run within 48 hours of data receipt.
3) Create readout deck template; schedule dry-run on June 26 if readout is June 29.

Attachments: POC_Playbook_Aurora_v1.pdf, Evaluation_Checklist.xlsx

—Marcus
